# Electric Boiler (ElectricBoiler)

> **Class**: `ElectricBoiler` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hvac_thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Electrode / Electric Resistance Boiler for rapid steam generation.

Constant efficiency, ramp-limited electric input. Validity: 0 to p_max_mw.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'ElectricBoiler'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `p_max_mw` | `float` | `20.0` | MW | - |
| `efficiency` | `float` | `0.99` | 1 | Conversion thermal efficiency |
| `ramp_rate_mw_min` | `float` | `40.0` | MW/min | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_cmd` | MW | Electrical consumption power request |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_actual` | MW | Actual active power absorbed |
| `Q_thermal_MW` | MW | Useful steam or hot water thermal power delivered |

## Validity and notes

Validity: 0 to p_max_mw.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import ElectricBoiler

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('electricboiler', model=ElectricBoiler(), outputs=['P_actual', 'Q_thermal_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['electricboiler'].tail(2))
```
